title: chats-catalog — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins the migrated chats catalog envelope (MYM5, §10.4.1, myne-md/myne#675): the v0.2 seal (v0.2 KEK via derive_subkey_versioned + v0.2 AAD) over the same roster bytes, and the bidirectional generation refusal. The header version byte stays 0x01 (the envelope version, not the generation), like the themes singleton family. Two case kinds: 'encrypt' (decode-verified fixture + magic/version pins) and 'decode_fail_v0_1' (the v0.1 expectation refuses MYM5 at the magic check, before any decryption). The Rust reference implementation lives at protocol/src/chats_catalog_blob.rs (main myne repository).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'chats-catalog/v0.2/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

input_root_key_hex.description: 32-byte root_key (hex). The runner derives the v0.2 catalog KEK via derive_subkey_versioned(V0_2, root_key, ChatsCatalogKey).

input_plaintext_hex.description: Canonical roster JSON bytes (hex), same bytes the v0.1 envelope seals.

expected_magic_ascii.description: The migrated catalog magic. Read straight off the expected bytes by the runner.

expected_version_byte_hex.description: The header version byte stays 0x01 in v0.2 — it versions the envelope, not the generation. Pinned as a const precisely because it looks like an inconsistency.

oneOf.title: decode_fail_v0_1 — pin the v0.1 expectation refusing MYM5

expected_error.description: The v0.1 expectation refuses a next-major blob at the magic check, before any decryption.
